_comment: To add more downstream repositories, add them to the repositories array. Each repository should have: owner, repo, gemspec (the .gemspec filename), and description (for the job name). Set "experimental": true only while a known integration migration is pending (its legs continue-on-error); false keeps them required. relaton's legs are required again: pubid 2.0.0.pre.alpha.21 ships on the released parsanol 1.3.63 and relaton's fixtures are reconciled (#409).
